modules.module_title: Monitoring & Maintaining the Fuel Station Solar rooftop installation

pcs.pc_description: Understand different strategies adopted for maintenance of a solar roof top PV system- Routine maintenance, Preventative maintenance, Corrective or Reactive maintenance, and Condition-based maintenance.
Understand the objective of preventive maintenance
Understand the objective of a PV system monitoring on regular basis
Track energy production and usage in real- time
Identify dips in output or problems with individual panels, batteries, or other system components.
Understand the sensors and communication devices attached to solar arrays
Read, record, & store the voltage, current, and power output in real time
Carry out routine inspection and servicing of equipment to prevent breakdowns and unnecessary production losses.
To regularly check basic maintenance elements such as modules, inverters, charge controllers, and batteries.
Carry out a thorough inspection of PV modules visually to look for any issues
Look for physical damage to frame and glass etc and repair the same
Identify any delamination or change in color of the module's outer layer due to separation of bonds between glass and frame
Look for any moisture or corrosion present in the PV modules
Locate any burned connections inside module (hot spots)
Identify any grounding corrosion of wires or frame
Establish any weakness or corrosion in the PV Array mount
Clean the PV panels to remove any dirt, leaves and debris accumulation.
To regularly check the proper working of batteries -electrolyte level, soiling of connectors etc
Use AC/DC clamp meter and earth tester
use infrared (IR) thermometer to check any higher temperatures (hot spots) occurrence at circuit breakers, terminals, wires etc.
Check Junction box and module connection failures
Check bypass Diode failures
Rectify any open circuiting leading to arcing
Maintain a checklist of all required maintenance tasks and their recommended intervals
utilize Condition-based maintenance (CBM) by using real-time data to prioritize and optimize maintenance and resources
Maintain a proper record of all the maintenance issues faced and rectified along with root cause analysis
Understand the Importance of Solar PV Safety
Understanding the top risks associated with Solar PV and how to avoid the same
Prevent shock and electrocution from energized conductor
to check that the solar PV system is grounded correctly and that all wiring is securely insulated
ensure that all electrical connections are secure and corrosion-free to prevent this risk.
Ensure that the system is complying to the codes & standards and that all of the equipment is in good operating order
Install Arc Fault Circuit Interrupters (AFCIs) on the inverter or the AC breaker panel to detect and interrupt an arc fault before it can cause damage or fire.
Install Ground Fault Circuit Interrupters (GFCIs) to detect and interrupt ground faults can prevent damage and fire hazards.
Ensure Proper Labeling of electrical equipment with warning labels - hazard level and the necessary personal protective equipment to be worn
to wear the appropriate safety gear, such as rubber-soled shoes and gloves, face shield, hard hat etc
understand the hazards associated with an arc flash and how to work safely around electrical equipment.
Install a DC disconnect switch can help to quickly and safely isolate the DC side of the solar PV system in the event of an arc flash.
Conduct regular risk assessments with an arc flash and implementing appropriate measures to reduce or eliminate those risks.
Implement an emergency response plan in place to minimize the damage and injuries in the event of an accident
Use proper fall protection equipment, such as harnesses and safety lines, to prevent falls from the rooftop.
Ensure all equipment and tools are in good working condition before using them.
Follow proper lifting techniques to prevent injuries when lifting and moving heavy equipment or materials.
Use lifeline while working on an industrial shed roof to prevent falls from heights
Report any near miss event
Document all the safety related issues faced and mitigation
